topics.python: Python easy, powerful. Use for automation, AI, web (Django/Flask/FastAPI), data. Best practices: PEP8, virtual env, type hints, tests.
topics.system_design: System design: Requirements → Capacity → High level → Deep dive → Bottlenecks. Key: Scalability, Reliability, Availability. Use: Load balancer, Cache (Redis), DB sharding, CDN.
topics.security: Cybersecurity: Never hardcode secrets, use HTTPS, hash passwords (bcrypt), SQL injection prevention, XSS, CSRF. Update dependencies.
topics.windows: Windows control via Python: pywin32, psutil, pyautogui, PowerShell. For full laptop: file ops, registry, services, task scheduler.
